record.title: Evaluate Linux transition composition and current RF frontier
record.intent: Determine the next concrete boundary from actual stock records and reviewed host composition.
requirements: Independently evaluate supplied composition controls and exact transaction/lease/clock/ownership/reader/UI/thermal bounds, distinguishing remaining implementation gaps from physical unknowns. Bind the actual original A1 decision and source/return-control evidence without creating missing B/A2 records or historical reducer acceptance.

Reassess remaining current authorization and original 4800/2400-second reservations. If complete reviewed controller, accepted current A1 and actual lease/ownership cannot all support the full reversible sequence, record the exact boundary and future invocation requirements rather than mutate or shorten controls.

This decision grants no physical native transition itself. Any later actual B/A2 requires separate inspected expected-revision admission and committed/pushed tasking plus current input gates. At the active deadline checkpoint known-safe ordinary/owned helper state and evidence with a clean pushed checkout; do not extend authorization.
acceptance: The composition and actual stock evidence yield an explicit next RF action or a precise remaining blocker.
